notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial Launched!
notes.content:
[h3]After more than two years of development and polish, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh_25_05_28]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] is now fully released![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33744186/1e668665040bf3a50180ed0ab3479e39661474b0.jpg[/img]

[h3]Out of Early Access.[/h3]
The visual novel is complete with all its planned features and fully playable from the start to the bitter end! ːedgardoː With multiple endings.

[h3]Partial voice acting added[/h3]
All seven chapters now include some voice lines to better establish the characters.

[h3]Mac version now available[/h3]
The game now supports both Windows and macOS.

[h3]Artbook DLC released[/h3]
Take a behind-the-scenes look at sketches, concepts and early drafts in a beautifully compiled PDF! Grab the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3699290/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial__Artbook/]artbook[/url] and support future creative projects.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27939525/abb2b1e1af95620866f824f4813859f17f9f3fb5.jpg[/img]

I've poured a lot into this visual novel over the past years - writing, editing, coordinating, testing... It was the story I really wanted to tell, and I hope you'll enjoy the finished version.

[h3]Now is the perfect time to jump in - or back in![/h3]

If you've enjoyed it, a short review or share on social media really helps spread the word!

Thank you for supporting indie games and making releases like this possible!💜

- Lamb

tags.feature: Partial voice acting added
Mac version now available
Artbook DLC released

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Final chapter released!
notes.content:
[h2]The final chapter of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_25_03_29]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] is live![/h2]
[img]https://clan.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/921c24afc2131b1ccf16dc450c5eb54da1ee9aa9.jpg[/img]
The game now has 7 endings reachable from the last chapter, in addition to a couple of "bad endings" it had before.

The total word count is now over 160.000 words, making it my longest VN so far. ːdazed_yetiː

Plans for the future involve implementing partial voice acting and making a Mac OS version of the Cursed Trial, as well as planning a new potential game in this universe. ːhappy_yetiː

notes.title: Demonheart: The Cursed Trial - Chapter 6 Released!
notes.content:
[h3]My latest project in the Demonheart world just got a major update![/h3]

[h2][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_24_09_24]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] Chapter 6 is out![/h2]

With around 21.900 words of new content, this takes the game over 133.000 words - my longest game so far. 

The story continues, with only one more chapter left to go (which will have multiple endings.)

I hope you'll enjoy the new addition! 

[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/9839c1bd8183b6c3b1bd295c68fb720df5b72fe6.jpg[/img]

The Cursed Trial is a murder mystery / romance in which Raze ("The Seer") has captured a group of humans for the entertainment of his demonic master. (Raze doesn't really have a master, he just made a deal with someone and is playing along.)

The main character, whose name you can change, can fall in love with two of her fellow captives.

[b]If you haven't joined in on the adventure yet, consider doing so now by wishlisting or purchasing [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=rc_24_09_24]The Cursed Trial[/url] - your interest and support help me develop these niche games![/b]

tags.feature: Chapter 6 is out!

notes.title: Content Update v2.00
notes.content:
[h3]A content update that has long been in the works is now live![/h3]

Between writing the chapters of the new [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh_v200]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url], I managed to finish the update right before the fourth anniversary of Hunters! Yay! ːWitchAriː

I've been intending to update Hunters for a long time, but delayed it for multiple reasons, including my burnout with its main characters and the way the pandemic started right after the game's launch. Since then, I have worked on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1424300/Jester__King/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh_v200]Jester / King[/url], [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711620/Demonheart_The_Ice_Demon/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh_v200]The Ice Demon[/url] and the most recent [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh_v200]Cursed Trial[/url], but I always kept in the back of my mind those extra maps for Hunters that I never quite finished and how I owed the players an update to try to fix the ending which did feel rushed.

While working on this update, I remembered how much effort I put into Hunters, what it took to get every single map working, and how nice it felt to have the freedom of adding random new details and new NPCs to an RPG. I'm grateful that I've worked on this game in the first place, and grateful to all of you for believing in my work enough to purchase it, even though it may not have met everybody's expectations. (It's hard when everything I make is always compared to the first Demonheart.)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33744186/5e222dfaf543c936985b553bffa225f8e7bc9733.png[/img]
This update adds some content between the Serpents' Keep and Thayn's Inferno, as well as some conversations in Thayn's Inferno to slow down the pacing a bit. It also contains some general polish. Below is a list of changes.

[i]Please note: It might be safest to start a new game. The changes to the journal and some inventory items only appear when you start fresh.[/i]

[h1]Content:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added 7 new areas between the Serpents' Keep and Thayn's Inferno, including a small village, a forest and an infamous tavern run by outlaws.
[*] The witch Emmerie will no longer be in the Serpents' Keep, although you need to search for her in the area where she used to be.
[*] Added several new NPCs to talk to in the new areas, and two new quests, each with a few objectives and multiple journal entries. You can choose to work for or against the local outlaws, or a bit of both, but eventually you'll have to decide. ;) 
[*] Companions comment on the new events.
[*] Added descriptions about what happens to the remains of the Python and Love Jayden when they die their final deaths. I also made edits to their graphics. (This is relevant for the Cursed Trial. :'))
[*] Made reading Love Jayden's journal unskippable - not sure if it was possible to run through the game without reading it, but I thought it would be a pity if you missed it. :') Companions will tell you to do it if you attempt to leave the room.
[*] Added some companion comments in the Serpents' Keep and Thayn's Inferno.
[*] Modified Thayn's Inferno to include more interactable objects and a new monster that talks.
[*] Added a conversation with the companions before the Thayn confrontation.
[*] Added small references to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711620/Demonheart_The_Ice_Demon/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh_v200]Demonheart: The Ice Demon[/url] and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh_v200]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url] - although the latter may be more difficult to spot, especially before Chapter 4 arrives. (It's the green book from the Wise Woman's home and another piece of information found somewhere. :))
[*] The adult Raze meets a new cat.
[*] There are more plants to collect, to hopefully max out your poison skill or get the healing salves achievement if you haven't already done so. =') Added more alchemy tables to the late game, so you can use those ingredients.
[*] The total word count has increased from 85.000 to 94.000+.
[/list]
[h1]Engine:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Increased the number of save slots from 50 to 100.
[*] Save files now display the year, month and day when they were made. This turned out useful for replaying a 4-year-old game :)
[*] Altered the trap detection formula: it should be around 20% faster. Changed the trap detection sound so it no longer haunts your nightmares (though the new one might. ːgameoverprismː)
[*] Increased damage of Brash's skills, since he somehow felt like the weakest party member. :)
[*] One map in Thayn's Inferno has changed - a hallway has been deleted and a new room added, which might mess up save files if you made them in that part of the map.
[*] Deleted one old duplicate map from January 2020 which was replaced two days after the game launched. If you have saves from two days after the game launched in Raze's Inferno, they would no longer work.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33744186/ae6e524cd76496b83fd97c9aaf8fb916154939cd.png[/img]
[h3]If you don't want to miss any future updates or new games in this series, please follow [url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/rollingcrown]Rolling Crown[/url] on Steam![/h3]

notes.title: Cursed Trial - Demo Update
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/33404344/b7238acd9f3138009f0174eb5580a6a91ba2728b.jpg[/img]

While working on the third out of the seven chapters of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23-10-20]Demonheart: The Cursed Trial[/url], I went back to the first chapter (demo) and made some edits. There are a lot of small changes which you may or may not notice if you replay.

Changes:
[list]
[*] Rephrased many lines of narration and dialog.
[*] Changed some expressions and sprite positions. Changed Ran's expression on several occasions into less childish and more manly ones. ':)
[*] Added a few new choices and NPC lines - nothing crucial, but these changes will mess with old saves. Old alignment and relationship points will be preserved, but you may end up on the wrong line when you reload.
[*] Started silently tracking Janiya's approval. Old saves didn't track this, so it will be like your relationship with her was neutral. Which is not the worst it could be. ':)
[*] Changed some sound effects.
[/list]

[h1]The demo is available [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=23-10-20]here[/url]! Don't forget to wishlist the Cursed Trial![/h1]

Meanwhile, the third chapter is nearly finished, and when it's polished, there's a possibility of Steam early access! Stay tuned for news about it, and thank you for following!

notes.title: Update v1.35
notes.content:
We were recently informed that the game started crashing for Mac OS users, so in this new build we updated the version of the underlying engine, hoping it will fix this.

While testing the new build, we also fixed an issue that was possibly preventing achievements from getting activated if you unlocked them while Steam was offline. To see if you had any achievements saved locally that were waiting to get unlocked, start the game and they should get activated!

The demo for the new game will be launching on Tuesday!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2364560/Demonheart_The_Cursed_Trial/?utm_source=steam_news&utm_campaign=dhh1][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33744186/924df95aceabe5fe1c65f4c914d6ec2f495a23c0.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Jester / King Demo Update v1.06 - Voice Acting
notes.content:
I'm excited to announce an updated version of the Jester / King demo, now with voice acting!

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33404344/34ea3e9fab9de90204481b1b16b8f67fdd71d2bb.jpg[/img]

Note: The game will no longer allow you to load saves from versions prior to v1.06. I rewrote parts of the demo and changed the way character names are revealed, which broke the old saves.

There is still a lot of testing and polishing left to do for the full game, but I hope I can get it done in the next couple of months.

In the meantime, I've started commissioning art for a new VN in the Demonheart world and opened a [url=https://www.patreon.com/rollingcrown]Patreon[/url] where you can check how it's going. If you like what I'm making, please consider supporting me.
[url=https://www.patreon.com/rollingcrown][img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33404344/8696aa74a4c909634a02742ec6436a1a7852be61.png[/img][/url]
